Security_and_Automation_Boundary: Registered authenticator or corporate SSO reauthentication required before reset/unlock.
No identity step for advice; authenticated session required for group/certificate changes.
Approved catalog and entitlement only; purchases, non-standard software, and admin rights require approval.
Safe non-invasive diagnostics only; safety, damage, repair, replacement, or logistics require handoff.
Step-up verification using a still-registered factor or an approved recovery service. No knowledge-only verification.
Advice is low risk; mailbox permission or quota changes require authenticated admin tool and policy.
Standard pre-approved access only; privileged, external, sensitive, or SoD-relevant access requires approval.
Safe endpoint diagnostics only; multiple-user/site failures become incidents.
Bot never attempts resolution; immediate SOC handoff with evidence preserved; no containment without approval.
Safe queue/spooler diagnostics only; physical hardware faults route to facilities/IT ops.
Client-side cache/permission fixes only; platform-wide outages become incidents.
Standard enrollment/profile fixes only; lost device or wipe requires verification and security approval.
